thread.title: Lawmakers to hold final hearing on expanding access to homeownership in Lebanon

author: Keystone Today
title: Lawmakers to hold final hearing on expanding access to homeownership in Lebanon
text:
House Republican Policy Committee Chairman David H. Rowe, along with Representative John Schlegel and other lawmakers, will host the third and final hearing in a series titled “Expanding Access to Homeownership” to discuss solutions for making homeownership more affordable and attainable for families in Pennsylvania, according to a May 27 announcement.
The hearing is scheduled for Wednesday, May 27, at 10 a.m. at Lebanon City Hall, located at 735 Cumberland Street in Lebanon, Pennsylvania. Organizers said the event will be livestreamed online barring any technical difficulties.
Testifiers expected at the hearing include Sherry Capello, mayor of Lebanon City; Caitland Lockhart, executive director of the Lebanon Housing Collaborative; Bryan Smith, executive director of Lebanon County Christian Ministries; Christine Hartman, administrator for Community Action Partnership of Lancaster and Lebanon Counties; Jocelyn Stakem, CHIPP coordinator and housing specialist with the Lebanon County Mental Health/Intellectual Disabilities/Early Intervention Program; and Kyle Wegner, owner of Revital Home Co.
The series aims to address barriers faced by Pennsylvanians seeking homeownership and gather input from local leaders and experts on potential policy solutions.
Media inquiries can be directed to Nancy Nilson at 717-260-6238 or nnilson@pahousegop.com.
